title: Colombian fintech Plenti raises $3 million in Tether-led seed round
message_html: Colombian fintech Plenti raises $3 million in Tether-led seed round ...
snippet: Plenti, a Colombian fintech focused on currency movement and investment services, today announced a $3 million seed funding round led by Tether, the issuer of the USDT stablecoin, with participation from Verda Ventures.
